xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4618: CI runs the full suite on every .pan/ bookkeeping commit to main, starving PR checks of runners

plan.title: CI runs the full suite on every .pan/ bookkeeping commit to main, starving PR checks of runners
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs the full ~13-job suite on every push to main with no path filter and no concurrency group. ~95% of main commits are bookkeeping commits touching only .pan/** or .overdeck/memory/**, and runs for superseded PR and main heads keep their runners (48 unfinished runs at 11:50 on 2026-10-24). Once bookkeeping commits run no CI and superseded runs are cancelled, several main-CI readers give wrong answers: the default-branch test verdict reports 'no failing tests' after 10 commits without a decisive run, the DoD row 6 later-green fallback burns its 5-candidate budget on commits without CI, the Command Deck CI chip shows a false green from the guard workflow alone, and the Flywheel/recap skills read the newest run even when it is cancelled.
narratives.Proposal: Add paths-ignore ['.pan/**', '.overdeck/memory/**'] to CI's push trigger and a workflow-level concurrency group ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }} with cancel-in-progress. Readers classify commits by the CI evidence they carry, never by changed files (critique): the test-verdict reader widens to 100 commits and skips commits without test checks or with only cancelled ones; DoD row 6 skips candidates missing a required check (scan 50, probe 5); the Command Deck chip resolves the CI head as the head_sha of the newest push run of .github/workflows/ci.yml (workflow-runs endpoint, branch-head fallback on 404). pan reload already builds origin/main HEAD with no CI lookup and gets a regression test. Skills, the Flywheel role prompt, event-contract comments and developer docs state the newest-decisive-run rule.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing the pull_request trigger's events or adding a path filter to it
- Changing .github/workflows/no-planning-on-main.yml or any workflow other than ci.yml
- Reducing how often the backlog sequencer or Flywheel commit to main
- Per-project configuration of the bookkeeping paths or the CI workflow file
- Adding a CI lookup or CI gate to pan reload / build-from-origin.ts
- Changing DoD row 6's primary evidence or DEFAULT_MAIN_VERIFY_REQUIRED_CHECKS
- Filtering DoD candidates or CI heads by changed files or git pathspecs
- Schema changes to project.ci_suite_observed / project.ci_head_observed (comments only)
- Adding .overdeck/context/** to paths-ignore
- Raising any entry in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt

autoDecisions.summary: paths-ignore list is exactly ['.pan/**', '.overdeck/memory/**'] on on.push only; .overdeck/context/** stays outside
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names these two paths. Recent .overdeck/context changes land only inside code PR squash-merges, so they are never bookkeeping-only commits.

autoDecisions.summary: pan reload gets a regression test and no code change
autoDecisions.rationale: buildDashboardFromOriginMain always builds origin/main HEAD and never reads CI; a bookkeeping HEAD holds the same code as its parent, so the deploy is already correct. The issue's AC allows 'test or a recorded dry run'.

autoDecisions.summary: Test-verdict reader: 100-commit window, 10-commit budget counted only on commits with test checks, null (unknown) when a full window has no test checks
autoDecisions.rationale: null makes ci-failure-feedback spend no attempt, which is the documented safe side; an empty set would blame the PR for a failure inherited from main.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the Command Deck CI chip in this issue by resolving a 'CI head' instead of documenting the false green
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says to fix any reader that assumes HEAD always has a run; without the fix the chip reports success 1/1 from the guard workflow and hides a red main, which the operator relies on.
The issue says so explicitly, and DoD row 6 requires its reject-planning-paths check name.

autoDecisions.summary: Readers identify CI-bearing commits by the checks/runs they carry, not by changed files
autoDecisions.rationale: The plan critique showed file-based filtering drops promote merges and misses mixed pushes, where GitHub runs CI at a bookkeeping tip; check evidence is correct in both cases and also handles cancelled runs.

autoDecisions.summary: CI head = head_sha of the newest push run from actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?per_page=1, falling back to the branch head on 404 or no runs
autoDecisions.rationale: ~24 bookkeeping pushes (each with a guard run) can sit above the newest CI run, so an all-workflows page could miss it; the workflow endpoint returns exactly the newest CI run in one small call.

autoDecisions.summary: Concurrency group ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }} with cancel-in-progress: true, applied as written by the operator
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator scope addition on the issue (2026-10-24T11:49Z); it reverses revision 1's choice to leave cancel-in-progress out, and readers are made to skip cancelled runs.

metadata.sizeJustification: The plan spans several subsystems but about 22 files, and items 3-6b fix regressions that items 1 and 1b (paths-ignore and cancel-in-progress in ci.yml) introduce: shipping the ci.yml change alone would open a window where the default-branch test verdict reports 'no failing tests' on a red main, DoD row 6 cannot find later green runs, and the Command Deck CI chip shows a false green; shipping the reader fixes first would test them against a ci.yml that skips and cancels nothing. The skills, contract comments and docs describe the same combined behavior. Every item is small and the DAG lets 6 of 10 items start in parallel.

items.title: Add paths-ignore for .pan/** and .overdeck/memory/** to CI's push trigger

expected_outputs: git diff exits 0 (no change to no-planning-on-main.yml)

narrative.Action: PRD work item 1. In .github/workflows/ci.yml add under on.push (after branches: [main]) the PAN-4618 comment block and paths-ignore: ['.pan/**', '.overdeck/memory/**']. Do not touch on.pull_request or any other workflow. Push over the SSH remote (gh OAuth lacks workflow scope); if the push is refused, stop and pan tell flywheel-orchestrator. The post-merge observation (no CI run for the next bookkeeping push) is in the PRD acceptance list and hazard H7; it is not an xBRIEF AC because it cannot be seen before merge.
